messages:
Anika: Quick follow-up from last night's GPU capacity incident. I spun up a tiny action tracker — need owners and concrete ETAs so this doesn't fall into the void. Main buckets: quota tweak, scheduler tuning, headroom policy, recurring surge detection.

Devon: I can own the quota request to infra. I'll validate current reservations + burst policy and file the request with cloud team. ETA: EOD Fri.

Maya: I'll take headroom planning and the KV-cache reuse check. We should decide on a conservative reserve (5-10%) and an automated ramp test. Propose a dry-run next Wed.

Tom: Scheduler tuning sounds like me. I want to try the backfill window reduction + priority preemption tweak we discussed. Small experiment: reduce batching window from 200ms -> 150ms for small jobs. Will run perf A/B on staging. ETA: WIP, results by Tue.

Anika: Thanks. Can we also add an alert rule for the recurring spike pattern? Ops noticed a 03:10 UTC spike that repeats ~weekly.

Devon: Good call. I'll add a short-term alert: GPU_util > 85% for 5m and incidence count > 3 in 24h -> page. Long term: anomaly detection task.

ops-bot: Created follow-up issue #3421: "GPU capacity followups — quota, scheduler, headroom, surge-detection" and added labels: incident-followup, priority-high. Assignee: unassigned.

SRE-Lead: Narrow asks: (1) Quota request doc + cloud ticket link, (2) Scheduler experiment perf graph, (3) Headroom policy doc with rollback plan, (4) Alert runbook snippet. Can we have all artifacts linked in the issue by next Monday?

Maya: I'll draft the headroom doc today. Will include rollback: auto-shrink reserve after 10m of low utilization and manual override.

Devon: Filing cloud ticket now: https://cloud.example/tickets/RED-6782 (placeholder). I'll update #3421 with ticket link.

Tom: Started the staging run for scheduler tweak. Minimal perf impact so far. Will paste logs to the issue when done.

Anika: Great. Quick tracker table (short):
```
ID | Owner  | ETA     | Status
3421 | TBD   | Mon     | open
Q-01 | Devon | 2026-04-03 | in-progress
S-02 | Tom   | 2026-04-02 | running
H-03 | Maya  | 2026-04-01 | drafting
A-04 | Devon | 2026-04-01 | alert-added
```

Anika: @Devon @Tom @Maya please drop links and short notes in #3421 and mark the checklist items done as you complete them. We'll reconvene in the weekly ops sync if anything slips. :thumbsup:

Devon: Will do. Marking myself owner for Q-01 now.

Tom: I'll update with staging perf graphs when complete.

Maya: Drafted headroom doc and pushed to the issue. Link: https://docs.internal/gpu-headroom-draft (internal).

SRE-Lead: Thanks team. If any blocker appears (cloud quotas or infra approvals), escalate to me and we'll fast-track.

Anika: Closing loop here — I'll run a quick status pulse on Monday morning and move any overdue items into the sprint backlog. Good work.
